title: Tighten the conditional selected BIT parent-stock bound
body:
## Summary

Add `research/selected-bit-ceiling-free-stock/`, a conditional all-width stock-bound refinement for the selected ordinary BIT producer. No new kappa, supplier admission or frontier change.

The sufficient bound changes as follows, not the production invoice:

```diff
- parent-stock coefficient sigma = 8194; ceil(log2(8*sigma)) = 17
+ parent-stock coefficient sigma = 6748; ceil(log2(8*sigma)) = 16
```

The exact certificate `2^17*42^28 < 64^28`, together with the active-node threshold 64, gives a ceiling-free depth envelope `D(n) <= (28/17)*log2(max(1,n))`. Charging the whole GL64 packet, including its high fibers and nine work roles, gives `log_q S(n,w) <= 6748*w*log2(max(1,n))`. For borrowing, stock is chosen from original width e before choosing k. The new coefficient is exactly 14/17 of the predecessor's sufficient bound.

This follows the revision-4 `selected-stock-envelope` card, refined after live overlap. The ordinary producer is BIT m=64/rank42; the separate complex m=73 supplier only constrains the shared exponent. Production row coefficient 18355, cutoffs and selected exponent remain unchanged.

Scientific base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`. Contribution: `378593574261e0b0915e7e8a83147aa640274fc8`. [Claim and finding](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2114).

## Evidence

The before bound is Adam Gall's conditional PR2084 at `8001a23b003bec5dff5e61edec907b652c475932`. Its packet/completed-leaf argument is credited. Sricharan Vagvala's PR2105 at `0aca64e29d43533743bb912ac8b77b434e04b84a` treats the distinct complex depth envelope and informed the inverse-threshold cross-check. Neither predecessor verifier is imported or executed.

After refinement, standard-library CPython 3.12.15 registered normal/optimized replays pass:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-bit-ceiling-free-stock
```

Observed output includes:

```text
PASS_SELECTED_BIT_CEILING_FREE_STOCK sigma=6748 predecessor=8194 ratio=14/17 widths=100001 ell=16 no_new_kappa
Ran 10 tests
OK
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/selected-bit-ceiling-free-stock outcome=completed
```

Coverage includes separate forward/all-child checks for all widths 0..100000, 196 threshold boundaries, 15 power probes up to 4097-bit atom counts, literal fixtures and optimized public-CLI source/receipt rejection controls. Source archives and the consumed assembler member are authenticated before use. Missing or corrupt results fail without regeneration. The universal conclusion rests on the written proof, not the finite fixtures.

Also passed: all 65 `test_research_*.py` workflow tests, `make selected-record-check`, syntax compilation, warnings-as-errors, metadata/pins and staged diff checks. Exact commands, source pins, scope, environment and open next questions are included. Canonical main remained unchanged at the submission checkpoint. Final overlap covered 380 open PRs and 779 discussion records with complete pagination and no warnings; relevant predecessor heads were unchanged. Metadata coverage is not a novelty guarantee.

Credit also remains with Josie Elliston/PR1956 and PR1965, ToikY/PR1990, DreamingOfClouds/PR589, eumemic, Rohan Arun/PR185, PR387 and PR1094, and Jeremy Kothe/PR1087.

## Merge danger

This is reversible and limited to a new opt-in research package. Frozen evidence, shared scientific inputs and the selected frontier are untouched.

The GL64 packet/compiler realization, fresh-field preservation and internally completed ordinary-leaf interface remain assumptions. Only the native first-stage fit comparison is checked. No full cold replay, physical/native admission, precision/tape discharge, formal-kernel proof, independent human review or hosted-CI success is claimed. The next useful work is a source-bound all-size parent/child field split and a realized completed-leaf borrowing contract.
